summary: Add a closed deterministic Tier0 recovery entrypoint callable from the native Samantha UID.
reason: Provide an out-of-Termux-UID actuator without duplicating Claw orchestration or recovery state.

tests.name: runtime-targeted
tests.evidence: 4 native-recovery entrypoint tests + 12 Tier0 tests PASS.

tests.name: live-shadow-dispatch
tests.evidence: Samantha UID dispatched to Tier0 entrypoint; emergency stop produced deferred receipt and prevented runtime mutation.

capabilities.reason: Provides the fixed Termux-side recovery actuator invoked by the native failure domain.

architecture.reason: Adds a static Tier0 entrypoint but no new daemon/scheduler/store/orchestrator; canonical ADR is maintained in ui-playbooks.

rollback: Promote previous Tier0 LKG, remove/revert the entrypoint commit, and restore the installer-backed-up Termux properties only if the native recovery feature is retired.
limitations: Full Tier0 release promotion follows source publication.
V1 native triggers do not include cloud push.
